target_concept.title: Choose models for footprint area and enclosed cone volume

prerequisites: Area of a circle from its radius
Right circular cone versus cylinder geometry

relation_candidates.condition: The required measure is the 2D circular base area; radius r

relation_candidates.meaning: Air enclosed in a right circular cone
relation_candidates.condition: The required measure is 3D interior capacity of a right circular cone; h is vertical height

construction_units.decision: Classify target quantity (2D footprint or 3D enclosed space) and reject mismatched units.

steps.action: Name exactly what must be measured
steps.why_valid: Covering a ground region consumes area in m²; storage or air occupies volume in m³.

steps.action: Inspect whether the geometry matches a circle, cylinder or cone
steps.why_valid: The circular base and the tapered enclosed body have different measure formulas and applicability conditions.

stages.label: Isolate the base
stages.visible: A circular footprint depends on radius, not height

stages.label: Enclose the tapered solid
stages.visible: A right cone needs base radius and vertical height to determine volume

diagnostic.wrong_idea: Use any familiar cone-sounding formula without checking what is measured
diagnostic.probe: If the height changes but radius does not, which desired measure changes?
diagnostic.repair: Separate the object from the requested quantity; match unit and geometry before selecting equation.

construction_units.decision: Compare candidate volume models and use a changed condition to test the selection independently.

steps.action: Contrast tapered cone with constant-cross-section cylinder
steps.why_valid: Equal base radii and heights do not make their volumes equal; the cone occupies one-third of that cylinder's space.
Area of the fixed circular base is invariant; enclosed cone volume scales with height.

stages.label: State candidate governing models
stages.visible: Circle area uses r²; cone volume uses r²h/3

stages.label: Check doubled height
stages.visible: At fixed radius, base area unchanged, cone volume doubled

construction_units.independent_check: Counterfactual height doubled at fixed base radius

diagnostic.wrong_idea: Use cylinder volume πr²h for a cone
diagnostic.probe: At fixed radius and height, compare cone and cylinder volumes and explain the difference in shape.
diagnostic.repair: Demand right circular cone assumptions and the 1/3 factor; verify independently with a height change.
